title: T21 Confirmation, False Signals and NO_TRADE

lines.text: Lesson twenty-one: confirmation, false signals and NO_TRADE. Why waiting is a decision too.
lines.say: Lesson twenty-one: confirmation, false signals and no trade. Why waiting is a decision too.

lines.text: Here's a fictional BTC chart. Twice, price climbed to about 60,000 and turned back down.
lines.say: Here's a fictional B-T-C chart. Twice, price climbed to about sixty thousand and turned back down.

lines.text: Now it's back near that zone, at 59,970. Tempting to think: this time it breaks out!
lines.say: Now it's back near that zone, at fifty-nine thousand nine hundred seventy. Tempting to think: this time it breaks out!

lines.text: But from this same past, price could break out to 60,350, drift sideways, or fall to 59,650.
lines.say: But from this same past, price could break out to sixty thousand three hundred fifty, drift sideways, or fall to fifty-nine thousand six hundred fifty.

lines.text: Nobody knows in advance which one will happen.
lines.say: Nobody knows in advance which one will happen.

lines.text: Confirmation is extra evidence, after a signal, that supports an idea. You met it in T17.
lines.say: Confirmation is extra evidence, after a signal, that supports an idea. You met it in T seventeen.

lines.text: For a breakout: a candle closes beyond the zone, and the next candles hold there.
lines.say: For a breakout: a candle closes beyond the zone, and the next candles hold there.

lines.text: Think of dark clouds. They make rain more likely, but don't promise it.
lines.say: Think of dark clouds. They make rain more likely, but don't promise it.

lines.text: Confirmation can raise or lower the odds. It cannot tell you what the next candle will do.
lines.say: Confirmation can raise or lower the odds. It cannot tell you what the next candle will do.

lines.text: Not all evidence is equal. Weak evidence is small or easy to fake, like one wick above a level.
lines.say: Not all evidence is equal. Weak evidence is small or easy to fake, like one wick above a level.

lines.text: Conflicting evidence points in different directions at the same time.
lines.say: Conflicting evidence points in different directions at the same time.

lines.text: Here, the trend leans up, but price is under resistance and volume is fading.
lines.say: Here, the trend leans up, but price is under resistance and volume is fading.

lines.text: When evidence is weak or mixed, the scale doesn't tip. That's a reason for NO_TRADE.
lines.say: When evidence is weak or mixed, the scale doesn't tip. That's a reason for no trade.

lines.text: A false signal looks real but doesn't follow through. A false breakout is the classic one.
lines.say: A false signal looks real but doesn't follow through. A false breakout is the classic one.

lines.text: Watch this candle. It pokes up to 60,090, above the zone, then closes at 59,960, back below.
lines.say: Watch this candle. It pokes up to sixty thousand ninety, above the zone, then closes at fifty-nine thousand nine hundred sixty, back below.

lines.text: Say someone bought 0.01 BTC at 60,060 on that poke. At the close: −1.00 USDT, before fees.
lines.say: Say someone bought zero point zero one B-T-C at sixty thousand sixty on that poke. At the close: minus one U-S-D-T, before fees.

lines.text: A wick above a level is not a close above it.
lines.say: A wick above a level is not a close above it.

lines.text: Momentum is how strongly price is moving. A fade is when each push gets smaller.
lines.say: Momentum is how strongly price is moving. A fade is when each push gets smaller.

lines.text: Like a ball rolled uphill: it keeps going for a while, but slower and slower.
lines.say: Like a ball rolled uphill: it keeps going for a while, but slower and slower.

lines.text: Here, four green candles gain 80, then 50, then 25, then only 10 USDT.
lines.say: Here, four green candles gain eighty, then fifty, then twenty-five, then only ten U-S-D-T.

lines.text: A fade is a warning sign, not proof. Price can fade, then push on again.
lines.say: A fade is a warning sign, not proof. Price can fade, then push on again.

lines.text: Hindsight bias: after you see what happened, it feels like it was obvious all along.
lines.say: Hindsight bias: after you see what happened, it feels like it was obvious all along.

lines.text: Looking back at this chart, the breakout seems certain. Of course it went up!
lines.say: Looking back at this chart, the breakout seems certain. Of course it went up!

lines.text: But at decision time, the right side was hidden. You only had this.
lines.say: But at decision time, the right side was hidden. You only had this.

lines.text: Old charts look clearer than live ones. Judge a decision by what was known at the time.
lines.say: Old charts look clearer than live ones. Judge a decision by what was known at the time.

lines.text: NO_TRADE means you looked, and decided not to open a position. It's an active choice.
lines.say: No trade means you looked, and decided not to open a position. It's an active choice.

lines.text: Like a batter leaving a ball outside off stump. You don't have to play every ball.
lines.say: Like a batter leaving a ball outside off stump. You don't have to play every ball.

lines.text: Write down what you'd need to see. For example: a 5-minute close above 60,050, then a hold.
lines.say: Write down what you'd need to see. For example: a five-minute close above sixty thousand fifty, then a hold.

lines.text: Until then: NO_TRADE. No fees, no new risk. At most, you miss a move.
lines.say: Until then: no trade. No fees, no new risk. At most, you miss a move.

lines.text: A common mistake: judging a decision only by what happened next.
lines.say: A common mistake: judging a decision only by what happened next.

lines.text: You waited, then price went up. Was waiting wrong? Not if the evidence was weak.
lines.say: You waited, then price went up. Was waiting wrong? Not if the evidence was weak.

lines.text: A good decision can have a bad outcome, and a bad one can get lucky.
lines.say: A good decision can have a bad outcome, and a bad one can get lucky.

lines.text: So review your reasons, not just the result. Was the evidence clear, or were you guessing?
lines.say: So review your reasons, not just the result. Was the evidence clear, or were you guessing?

lines.text: Your turn. Same zone, 60,000 to 60,050. Let's reveal new candles one at a time.
lines.say: Your turn. Same zone, sixty thousand to sixty thousand fifty. Let's reveal new candles one at a time.

lines.text: Candle one wicks to 60,070 but closes at 60,030, inside the zone. Two small candles follow.
lines.say: Candle one wicks to sixty thousand seventy but closes at sixty thousand thirty, inside the zone. Two small candles follow.

lines.text: Volume is falling. What's sensible: A, buy, B, sell, or C, wait? Pause if you need more time.
lines.say: Volume is falling. What's sensible: A, buy, B, sell, or C, wait? Pause if you need more time.

lines.text: C, wait. No candle closed above the zone, and the pushes are fading. Weak evidence.
lines.say: C, wait. No candle closed above the zone, and the pushes are fading. Weak evidence.

lines.text: A is tempting, but a wick is not a breakout. And B? Nothing confirms a drop either.
lines.say: A is tempting, but a wick is not a breakout. And B? Nothing confirms a drop either.

lines.text: Before you rely on confirmation, know its limits.
lines.say: Before you rely on confirmation, know its limits.

lines.text: Confirmed signals still fail. And waiting for confirmation often means a worse entry.
lines.say: Confirmed signals still fail. And waiting for confirmation often means a worse entry.

lines.text: False breakouts can trigger stops, and stops can slip. Leverage makes each loss bigger.
lines.say: False breakouts can trigger stops, and stops can slip. Leverage makes each loss bigger.

lines.text: These are fictional examples, not advice. NO_TRADE is always allowed.
lines.say: These are fictional examples, not advice. No trade is always allowed.

lines.text: Let's recap.
lines.say: Let's recap.

lines.text: One: confirmation is evidence, not certainty. The same past can lead to different futures.
lines.say: One: confirmation is evidence, not certainty. The same past can lead to different futures.

lines.text: Two: weak or conflicting evidence, a false breakout or a fading push are reasons for care.
lines.say: Two: weak or conflicting evidence, a false breakout or a fading push are reasons for care.

lines.text: Three: NO_TRADE is a real decision. Judge it by your reasons, not the result.
lines.say: Three: no trade is a real decision. Judge it by your reasons, not the result.

lines.text: Check yourself: you waited, then price rose. Was waiting a mistake?
lines.say: Check yourself: you waited, then price rose. Was waiting a mistake?

lines.text: Not if the evidence was weak. Judge the reasons.
lines.say: Not if the evidence was weak. Judge the reasons.

lines.text: Next up: T22, position sizing and risk budget. Size a position from the risk you accept.
lines.say: Next up: T twenty-two, position sizing and risk budget. Size a position from the risk you accept.
